full_judgment: This Rule is directed against an appellate Judgment and order of reversal arising out of an election petition. The Election Tribunal set aside the election and declared the petitioner to be the elected Chairman of the concerned Union Parishad. The learned District Judge, Feni on appeal reversed the judgment and order of the Election Tribunal and up held the election of the opposite party No.1 as the elected Chairman of the said Parishad.
